device.model: X110TS (the Polish Conax "PL SMART HD+" build)
device.type: DVB-S2 HD twin-tuner PVR satellite receiver with Conax Smart HD+ card reader and CI+ slot
device.soc: ALi M3606 (the main-code chunk's version "M3606 2Tuner", the seecode chunk's "M3606 SEE"; the main code is the SDK's "M3602 HD STB" / "S3602 HD STB" platform build, SDK4.0ba.8.0_Combo)
device.family: M3602 (chips/m3602.py), matched by the main-code chunk's version; chip ID 0x3603 (chipId)
device.demod: internal (NIM_S3501_0 / NIM_S3501_1 for the two satellite tuners)
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 at I2C 0x63 (DVB-S2) + MaxLinear MxL101SF at I2C 0x60 (DVB-T)

image.version: 1.1.9 PL SMART HD+ (main-code chunk 111000000003002 "M3606 2Tuner"; bootloader << SDK4.0ba.4.2_20110225 >>; Libcore 7.15.0@SDK4.0ba.7.15_20121024, Application 1.0.0@SDK4.0ba.8.0_Combo_20120530, HDMI_ALI_E_120522_1; the SEE's uLibcore 1.1.5a@SDK_20111126)
image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (DVBS2---0.1.0), HDCPKey 0x01FE00 (1.0.1), maincode 0x020000 (chunk "111000000003002" M3606 2Tuner, LZMA 0x10EF75 bytes -> 5.4 MB), seecode 0x180000 (M3606 SEE, LZMA 0xC9381 -> 2.4 MB), Radioback 0x280000 (1.0.0), ca 0x28FF80 (00000001), defaultdb 0x2A0000 (1.1.0), userdb 0x2BFF80 (1.0.0, 0x140070 bytes) -- the whole 4 MB flash

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the official download)
source.note: The manufacturer's USB update software_conax_x110ts_1-1-9_pl-smart_hd-_2014-04-07.original.zip; fetched 2026-10-18 from the mirror's Opticum / Opticum HD X110 TS folder.

simulator.note: Boots as the M3602 family with chip ID 0x3603, starts the SEE program at 0xA6000200, tunes its first preloaded Polish Smart HD+ channel (panel " ON ", "Strt", "----", "OOO1") and draws the channel banner (~337k non-background pixels at 80 M instructions, 381 GE commands) followed by "No Signal!".

desc: The official 1.1.9 Polish Conax Smart HD+ update (2014-04-07) of the Opticum X110TS twin-tuner satellite PVR (main-code chunk 111000000003002 "M3606 2Tuner", Libcore 7.15.0@SDK4.0ba.7.15_20121024).
Unlike the universal patch build (1.4.0C), the official Conax builds carry a ca chunk at 0x28FF80 in place of keydb.
